summary: Frontend-only testing of PreviewAppointmentsScreen.tsx bug fixes (5 specific issues from message #164). Code review confirms all 5 bugs are correctly implemented. UI testing was attempted but blocked by difficulty navigating to the Preview screen in the React Native Expo web app (requires creating multi-day appointments which has complex navigation flow).

integration_issues.issue: Unable to reach Preview screen via UI automation - requires creating a new multi-day therapy plan. The + button in appointments list was not clickable via Playwright.
affected_selectors: Top-right + button on appointments list page

bug_1_conflict_card_therapist_label.details: getSessionTherapistDisplay() function checks if session is conflicted AND conflict_type includes 'staff', returns 'Staff not available' instead of duplicate 'Unassigned'. Falls back to staff_assignments array, then staff_name, then 'To be assigned' for non-conflicted.

bug_2_redundant_originallyRequested_row.details: Code review confirms there is NO 'originalTimeSection' or 'appointments.orginallyRequested' being rendered anywhere in the expanded conflict section. The conflict section only shows: conflictMessage (lines 450-457), and alternativeSlots (lines 460-520). No raw i18n key display.

bug_3_duplicate_conflict_message.details: conflictMessage is extracted at line 382 and ONLY rendered inside the expanded section (lines 447-457). The main card header (lines 389-444) shows ONLY the warning icon, session number, date, time, staff name - NO text message. Comment at line 449 explicitly states 'BUG FIX #3: Single conflict message - only in expanded section'.

bug_4_alternative_cards_not_tappable.details: Alternative cards use TouchableOpacity with onPress={() => onSelectAlternative(alt)} at line 479. Handler handleSelectPerSessionAlternative (lines 759-784) correctly updates effectiveTimes state with new start/end/staff/room values and sets is_resolved: true. Visual feedback via alternativeOptionSelected style. data-testid='alternative-slot-{session_number}-{index}' for testing.

bug_5_missing_global_apply_to_all.details: GlobalAlternativesSection component (lines 278-339) renders plan-level alternatives as tappable options. planLevelAlternatives computed via useMemo (lines 600-653) - collects alternatives with plan_level: true, groups by time pattern, shows top 2 highest-coverage options. handleApplyGlobalAlternative (lines 790-826) updates effectiveTimes for ALL covered sessions. Rendered at lines 1087-1094 when hasConflicts && !allConflictsResolved && planLevelAlternatives.length > 0.

single_source_of_truth.details: effectiveTimes (Map<number, EffectiveTime>) at line 562 is the single source of truth. SessionCard reads from effectiveTime prop (lines 365-367). UI never recomputes from metadata. Both global and per-session handlers update this same state.

action_items: All 5 bugs appear correctly fixed in code - recommend manual testing on a mobile device or emulator
Backend must return 'plan_level: true' on alternative_slots for global alternatives to appear
Backend conflict_type must include 'staff' for 'Staff not available' message to show
critical_code_review_comments: Code architecture is clean with clear separation: EffectiveTime interface (lines 55-63), PlanLevelAlternative interface (lines 68-76), GlobalAlternativesSection component (lines 278-339), SessionCard component (lines 354-524)
Single source of truth pattern correctly implemented - effectiveTimes state initialized from API at lines 659-684, modified by handlers at lines 759-826
Alternative selection visual feedback: alternativeOptionSelected and alternativeTextSelected styles applied when isSelected is true
Confirm button correctly reads from effectiveTimes at lines 860-946

success_rate.frontend: Code Review: 100% (all 5 bug fixes verified in code). UI Testing: 0% (unable to navigate to Preview screen)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 bug fixes for PreviewAppointmentsScreen are implemented in code. To UI test: login as clinic admin -> Appointments -> + button -> Create multi-day therapy plan -> Preview screen. The app is React Native Expo web, sessionStorage auth loses tokens on URL navigation. Use in-app navigation only. Backend at Koyeb returns 200s. Key data-testids: global-alternatives-section, global-alternative-{index}, session-card-{session_number}, alternative-slot-{session_number}-{index}.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - This is a bug fix verification task, not RCA. All 5 reported bugs have been addressed: (1) Staff display uses getSessionTherapistDisplay() for conflict-aware messaging, (2) originallyRequested row completely removed, (3) conflict message only in expanded section, (4) alternative TouchableOpacity with proper onSelectAlternative handler, (5) GlobalAlternativesSection component with plan-level alternatives.
